claims.text: The graph-based features include Coreness, Strength, Eccentricity, Closeness, and Reciprocity.
Coreness and Strength reflect changes in the interactions around the targeted author.
Eccentricity measures the distance of a node from the farthest node in the graph.
Closeness indicates the average distance from a node to all other nodes in the graph.
Reciprocity measures the general reciprocity of exchanges between users.
